reading.body:
James Lankford's AI record in this data is mostly one bill: 12 of 15 events are votes on S. 2296, all cast on three days in September and October 2025.

The three non-S. 2296 items are two cosponsorships and one sponsorship, all dated 2026. He cosponsored S. 5471, the AI Systems Transparency Act, and S. 3062, the GUARD Act on age verification and responsible dialogue. He sponsored S.Res. 896, a sense-of-the-Senate resolution linking religious freedom, authoritative texts, and transparency in AI systems. The resolution is the only item here that is his own rather than a signature on someone else's text.

The S. 2296 votes split. He voted Yea on cloture, on the motion to proceed, on the motion to table an amendment, and on passage. Across eight amendment votes on October 9 he voted Yea twice and Nay six times. The data records the roll call numbers and amendment numbers but not what any amendment would have done, so the split cannot be read as a position on any specific provision.

What this does not cover matters. The summary says the set includes money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, but no contribution or fundraising event appears in the 15 points. There is no committee assignment, no hearing, no floor statement, and no explanation of what S. 2296 does. The record shows legislative activity on AI governance and transparency, not on compute, data centers, or electricity, so it says nothing about where this senator stands on the power and building constraints that govern AI scaling.

summary: Every dated AI event this site holds for James Lankford: bills sponsored or cosponsored, recorded votes on AI bills, and money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, newest first. 15 events.
